title: The context in use shows as a bar on its own row
body:
The status line showed the context as `ctx 28k/1.0M 3%`, one dim item among the settings and totals, and it was among the first items dropped on a narrow pane.

## Proposal

- A row of its own above the status line reads `context: 42%`, then a bar of `▰` for the share in use and `▱` for the rest, across the full width.
- The status line's `ctx` item goes.
- Before the agent reports a context size, the row has no percentage and an empty bar.
close_reason: Done in 31371bd. `header::draw_context` draws the row, and the percentage and filled glyphs take the colours the `ctx` item had.
